view.label: Typed Coordinated Work Atlas
view.claim_ceiling: Removable learner projection with one hand-authored standalone HTML candidate tested locally in Chromium; no projection compiler, accessibility result, comprehension result, runtime observation, authority, or promotion is established.

persistent_work_card.question: What is Work?
answer: Work is the uniform typed executable boundary.
A WorkDefinition is immutable and versioned and has exactly one body: a LeafBinding or a WorkGraph.
A WorkRun is one invocation of one WorkDefinition; Attempts belong to that run without changing its definition or authority basis.
Every composition form returns the same outer Work contract, so a pipeline is also Work and can be nested where a leaf can be used.
One root OrchestratorKernel expands every nested composite into one addressed plan.
noncollapse: Same outer contract does not mean same body.
Structural recursion does not create recursive orchestration authority.
A WorkDefinition is not a WorkRun, and a WorkRun is not an Attempt.

journal_dispositions: journal-accepted/duplicate event record—no new cursor transition
forbidden_inferences: terminal is not success or approval
protocol and journal do not decide or execute
authority-reference presence is not adapter admission or effect occurrence
projection is not domain state or authority

lenses.label: Structure
lenses.question: What is composed, and how does recursion remain one-root?
responsibilities: Show reusable WorkDefinition topology and selected composite bodies.
Separate definition nesting from a flattened run-plan projection.
Expose every composition form as syntax over EventTriggeredEdges.

lenses.label: Flow
lenses.question: What causally occurs when declared events release commands?
responsibilities: Show immutable text-labelled Command and Event occurrence cards.
Keep causation, delivery, per-run sequence, journal acceptance, wall time, and cursor fold distinct.
Show declared release edges and stale-attempt handling.
Use user-paced paper traces, never autoplay as evidence.

lenses.label: Ownership/Proof
lenses.question: Who owns each state, and what evidence may establish it?
responsibilities: Show named owners for domain status, confirmation, journal acceptance, and cursor state.
Separate authority-reference presence, adapter admission, and external-effect occurrence.
Expose evidence stage, profile, finding status, forbidden inference, and residue.
Preserve unsupported and indeterminate evidence instead of showing pass.

shared_selection.identity_rule: Graph node, outline row, relation row, occurrence card, and ownership row carry the same full semantic or occurrence identity.
shared_selection.focus_rule: Keyboard focus and semantic selection are separate state; changing a lens preserves selection.
shared_selection.projection_rule: Deleting every view record leaves design bytes, narrative ontology bytes, ontology.json bytes, semantic IDs, relations, sources, and residue unchanged.

required_fields: reducer version and freshness when applicable

negative_controls.mutant: Remove Ownership/Proof or display ownerless status.
negative_controls.reason: Collapses separately owned domain, confirmation, journal, and cursor state.

negative_controls.mutant: Draw or instantiate an OrchestratorKernel inside a composite.
negative_controls.reason: Turns structural recursion into recursive orchestration authority.

negative_controls.mutant: Merge command and event rails or omit textual message kinds.
Render journal acceptance as confirmation or call it an accepted decision.
negative_controls.reason: Persistence disposition does not create work-owned confirmation.

negative_controls.mutant: Merge authority-reference presence, adapter admission, and effect occurrence.
negative_controls.reason: Each requires separate evidence and none entails another.

negative_controls.mutant: Autoplay causality, move structural nodes, or order semantics by wall or arrival time.
negative_controls.reason: A projection cannot manufacture causation, ordering, or current state through motion or layout.

negative_controls.mutant: Use one universal graph as the landing view.
negative_controls.reason: Definition, occurrence, ownership, evidence, and layout become accidental merged meaning.

negative_controls.mutant: Use a universal green terminal/success state or projection-authored status.
negative_controls.reason: Terminal is structural and a projection does not own domain status.

negative_controls.mutant: Draw a cycle without a decision owner, positive bound, exhaustion edge, and no-next-attempt result.
negative_controls.reason: The graph loses its explicit finite bound.

negative_controls.mutant: Let the machine ontology or learner projection override DESIGN.md or write back a resolved conflict.
negative_controls.reason: A projection is not semantic authority and inclusion is not promotion.
